recentItems.title: BAEST - In Loathe And Love (OFFICIAL VIDEO)
recentItems.description:
BAEST "In Loathe And Love" (OFFICIAL VIDEO)

Taken from BAEST’s “Colossal” album out August 15th, 2025 via Century Media Records.
Order/stream here: https://baest.lnk.to/Colossal-Album 

Video credits:
Video materials by BAEST, Smukfest, Jakob Langvad, Nicolai Davis
Photo materials by Morten Holmsgaard, Jakob Langvad, Christina Rask Exner
Editor: Jakob Langvad
Produced by Jens Karlsson

In Loathe And Love - Lyrics:

Out of hate love comes trembling from above
Like bolts of thunder
From a clear blue sky
Jolting through my veins
Electrifying my heart
Electrocuting my soul

As I ascend into rapture
I wonder who i am
Infinity of passion, desire and hate 
The violent melody of life’s refrain
I am none

Frayed emotions
The walls of discretion are the first to fall
 
Falling into ruins
Decaying notions in the midst of it all 

Sacrificial embrace
Reconciliation

We forgot time, time and again
We waited and spent an eternity 
Until we forgot, time and again

We forgot time, time and again
We waited and spent an eternity 
Until we forgot time and time and again

Time and again
We waited and spent an eternity 
Until we forgot time and time again

Out of death life is growing from beyond
like worms from wet soil
like flowers in bloom
like maggots from a corpse
like flies from rotting flesh

As I descend into nothing
I wonder who we are
I melt with you together now
We are one

We become as one
forged together in this world

We forgot time, time and again
We waited and spent an eternity 
Until we forgot time and again

We forgot time, time and again
We waited and spent an eternity 
Until we forgot time and time and again

Time and again
We spent an eternity
Until we got forgotten by time and time again

In loathe and love
In loathe and love
In loathe and love, we forgot time
In loathe and love, we fall from grace

recentItems.description:
INSOMNIUM – Arch of the Sky (OFFICIAL VIDEO)  

New single “Arch of the Sky” by INSOMNIUM, out now via Century Media Records. Taken from the upcoming album “Netherworlds” out October 16th, 2026. Pre-Order now: https://insomnium.lnk.to/NetherworldsID


Video directed and produced by Patric Ullaeus rEvolver Film Company AB 
Music: Ville Friman 
Lyrics: Niilo Sevänen, Ville Friman 
Produced by Miiro Varjus and INSOMNIUM 
Recorded and engineered by Miiro Varjus @ Sonic Pump Studios, Helsinki 
Mixed by Jens Bogren @ Fascination Street Studios, Örebro 
Mastered by Tony Lindgren @ Fascination Street Studios, Örebro 
Keyboards arranged and performed by Aleksi Munter @ San Francisco, CA 
Additional editing by Rosku Lohiniva 
Drum recording assistant Otto Uusitalo 
Guitar technician Janne “Mehtis” Metsola  

Lyrics: 
The burning stars 
Light up the sky 
As chariot rides 
Across the heaven’s vault 
The hunt is on 
The chase to end it all 
Celestial ruin 
Of formless and divine 

Sing with the wind 
Speak to the stones 
Appease the spirits 
Soothe the weary souls 
Prepare the offering 
Rebuild the faith 
Conjure of sacrifice 
Veneration of the dead  

I bow to unseen 
I hear the spirits of the night 
I will never walk alone 
I dream with unseen 
I speak in tongues of twilight 
I will never die alone 

In liminal spaces 
In a speck of dust 
In fleeting moments 
In settling of the dusk 
We blaze our trails 
We forge our paths 
Prepare for the future 
And reconcile with the past 

And every day 
And every night 
We pray to fates 
We fear the call 
And every day 
And every night 
Fear and revere 
The Arch of the sky
